evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index rebounded to 31 (Fear) on 2024-08-13 from 25 (Extreme Fear) on 2024-08-12, indicating a minor relief and stabilization in market sentiment following severe early-August volatility. Although the 7-day average of 33.14 indicates ongoing macro caution compared to the 30-day average of 53.37, positive momentum out of extreme oversold sentiment historically exhibits a slight mean-reversion bias towards positive 24-hour returns.
limitations: Fear & Greed Index updates once daily and can lag fast intraday crypto market turns.
